name: Alamo Farmers' and Crafters' Market
tagline: Alamo Farmers' and Crafters' Market — Kalamazoo, MI
description: Alamo Farmers' and Crafters' Market is a farmers market in 8326 W. De Ave., MI, bringing together local growers, bakers, and makers. Shoppers can find seasonal produce, baked goods, and artisan products from area farms. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
